visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two Corgis are positioned on a light-colored tiled floor, looking up towards the camera with alert expressions and tongues slightly protruding. A person wearing white trousers and black shoes is partially visible at the bottom. The lighting is bright and typical of an indoor residential environment. (2) The camera tilts down to show the dogs from a top-down perspective, focusing on their rounded hindquarters and wiggling tail nubs as they move with excitement. The surrounding area includes plain walls and some scattered household objects in the background. (3) The dogs begin barking enthusiastically, their mouths opening wide and ears twitching. They hop slightly on their front paws while maintaining eye contact with the lens. The person's hand enters the frame from the right side, holding dark-colored treats. (4) The hand feeds a treat directly to the Corgi on the right, then places another treat on the floor for the second dog. Both dogs bow their heads to consume the food. (5) The final scene shows the dogs chewing their treats on the floor while the camera remains close. A chair and some cardboard boxes are visible in the background, reinforcing the home setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A man begins speaking in Mandarin with a cheerful and high-arousal tone, welcoming the first day of 2025. The background has a clean indoor room tone with no music. His speech is well-articulated with natural pauses. (2) The sound of dogs barking intermittently starts. Each bark is sharp, high-pitched, and has a wide spectral bandwidth, triggering a new acoustic phase. The man's voice remains dominant and energetic, responding to the animals. (3) The intensity of the barking increases as the dogs become more excited. You can hear the rhythmic scuffing of paws on the tile floor, which adds low-frequency thuds and friction sounds to the mix. The speaker's volume increases slightly. (4) A distinct rustling sound occurs as treats are handled. The barking suddenly stops as the dogs focus on the food. The acoustic environment shifts to low-intensity munching and crunching sounds with short-duration transients. (5) The speaker concludes the recording with a warm, lower-pitched blessing for viewers. The speech rate slows down significantly, and the vocal energy settles into a calm, positive state as the dogs continue to chew quietly.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a personal New Year's greeting from a pet owner to his audience, using his two Corgis as the central appeal. The intent is to share a wholesome, cute moment of pet interaction and celebratory spirit.
